message.content:
1. **Missing Logo Image:** The top-left logo area displays a broken image icon (alt text "Image") instead of the brand mark.
2. **Broken Category Images:** The "Home & Decor" and "Tools & Workshop" category cards show broken image icons and alt text at the top, disrupting the visual layout.
3. **Broken Product Images:** In the "Top featured products" section, the first two product cards ("Field No.10 Cast Iron Skillet" and "Stonewashed Linen Towel") have missing images with visible alt text.
4. **Overlapping UI Element:** A circular accessibility/menu widget (labeled "N") overlaps the left side of the hero section text and the first call-to-action button.
5. **Inconsistent Card Heights:** The product cards in the "Top featured products" section have uneven heights because the third card ("Halvor Brass Task Lamp") contains a large image while others are blank or smaller, causing misalignment of the "Add to Cart" buttons.
